purpose: Visual acceptance rules; these are checks, not claims that generation obeyed them.

gpt.tail: Root direction is upper right next to the body, partly occluded by hair and clothing. From that thick root the tail curves down along the right side, then left along the bottom. The lower inward-pointing tapered end is the true terminal tip. NEVER reverse root and tip or treat the upper body-side section as the tip. Preserve original edge scales; do not append any separate tip, leaf, fin, plume, tuft, arrow or ornament. First-frame pitfall: frontal idle/greenscreen often shows a thick body-side segment that models misread as the tip; add a structure ref that makes pelvic root→low tip unambiguous, keep tip below the knee near the feet, and reject clips that invert in the first 1–2s. See docs/animation-lab/gpt-jimeng-q-handoff.zh-CN.md.

tailBodyLanguage.idle: Occasional small relaxed sway with a soft pause; do not freeze or wag continuously at a constant speed.
tailBodyLanguage.happy: One or two gentle side-to-side sways timed to the smile, driven from the body-side root with delayed motion toward the tip. Keep the character's restrained temperament.
tailBodyLanguage.shy: Gradually curl the same tail inward toward the near leg and body, lightly wrapping the lower leg if the geometry remains clear; hold briefly, then visibly uncoil and recover. No sudden pose replacement.
tailBodyLanguage.recovery: Reduce amplitude gradually and return continuously to the neutral tail curve. Preserve tail length, thickness order, root attachment and the unique tapered tip in every frame.
reject: static pasted tail during expressive action
motion only at an added tip
tail passing through legs or dress

otherChecks: full body and tail in frame

claude.excludeAsQFirstFrame: public/portraits/claude.jpg is normal-proportion CG identity only; never mix as Q first frame
claude.bookAndHands: One brown patterned book always present with clear left/right grip ownership. Two arms only. Do not dissolve the book like a temporary prop; do not teleport it into the other hand; do not let pages or spine pass through wrists or face. Before video, still-check shoulder–elbow–wrist–book on both sides.
claude.hairAndSilhouette: Keep flower ornament + black ribbon, full orange hair silhouette, shoes and fingers inside frame. Reject cropped hair tips, floating ribbon, or swapped flower side.
claude.personaTone: Gentle, earnest, slightly reserved; warmer eye contact and smile than GPT. No exaggerated jumping, no constant blush-only acting, no horns/wings/tail.
claude.neutralPoseN: Shared book-holding standing pose N for ordinary clips: start and end on N. Sleep/Dock/walk need dedicated bridge states; do not hard-cut S→N or hide mismatch with long crossfades. See docs/animation-lab/CLAUDE-ACTION-HANDOFF.zh-CN.md and DSH-PROMPT-LESSONS-FOR-CLAUDE.zh-CN.md.
otherChecks: same amber eyes and flower ribbon
book cover pattern and thickness stable
no second character in solo clips

otherCharacters.gemini: Preserve existing cat ears, eyes, star ornament and tail; do not invent extra stars, a second tail or extra ear pairs.
otherCharacters.glm: Preserve exact existing black-fox reference; do not add or remove accessories based on a conflicting verbal persona description.
otherCharacters.kimi: Preserve the current version of asymmetric clothing and head ornament; do not invent a book or change to another community design.
otherCharacters.grok: Preserve the current blonde/dark-gold gothic chibi version; do not substitute a different fan design.
